newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan funds' yen sales seen by mid-Dec -- bankers.
newsitem.headline: Japan funds' yen sales seen by mid-Dec -- bankers.

text.p: Yen sales related to fresh foreign securities investment by Japanese pension fund bodies are expected to emerge by the middle of this month, bankers said on Monday.
Such sales would likely be a factor to support the dollar against the yen ahead of the end of the year, when market conditions tend to thin out, they said.

The bankers said the sales against foreign currencies by pension funds were likely to emerge through Japanese trust banks and other financial institutions and that they were expected to total around 300 billion yen.
